cityScopes.meridian: 147 unchanged native parcel polygons passed all eight qualification gates in bounded cells around the UN/WUP locator. Fresh independent metric audit (EPSG:32611) found zero invalid polygons, identity conflicts, duplicate geometry, material overlaps, or operation errors. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, and currentness are not established.
